description.value: Mount Pleasant Vintage & Provisions is a cocktail bar and Argentinian-style wood-fired grill tucked into Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, described on its own site as 'an unassuming cocktail bar disguised as a postmodern thrift shop.' The bar runs an ever-rotating cocktail list with an emphasis on forward-thinking techniques alongside elevated classic bar food cooked over wood and charcoal. It has earned recognition from The Pinnacle Guide (one pin, 'Excellent') and hosted the North America's 50 Best 2025 gala, signalling a destination-worthy stop for cyclists wanting a full sit-down meal and craft drinks.
